headline: Marban Hollow Surges as Gutter Clash Persists
war_summary: Three hours on the wires have cooled the northern flashpoints and shifted the weight south. Marban Hollow now leads the late returns with five changes in two hours and thirty in the day around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, standing at four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral, while Weathered Expanse follows with three in two and fifty-one in the day around Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch at four Warden, three Colonial and two neutral. Gutter remains the day's busiest board with ninety-one changes in twenty-four hours, though only two in the last two around Kuoppa and The Parras, now listed wholly Colonial. Olavis Wake eases to three in two and fourteen in the day around Iltaku and Kulkue at two Warden and three Colonial, and Pari Peak to one in two and fourteen in the day at Pariah. Kuura Strand shows two late changes at Martti amid sharp casualties. Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle still report heavy daily losses without a recorded change, and Nevish Line, Palantine Berm, Stlican Shelf and Linn Mercy have gone quiet in the last two hours.
